packageRules.description: The plugin pins wrangler exactly, and a split leaves two wranglers in the tree. Major updates join this group rather than splitting off.

typescript stays below 6.1.0, the top of typescript-eslint's typescript peer range, because typescript-eslint reads types through the 6.x compiler API that TypeScript 7 does not expose, until typescript-eslint supports TypeScript 7 and this rule and the @typescript/native alias both go: https://typescript-eslint.io/users/dependency-versions
